# Disagreement Log — 1 Kings Chapter 17
**Reviewed by:** SOPHIA | **Date:** 2026-03-11

---

## Summary
17 verse(s) flagged for significant translation divergence.

### Verse 1
**EMET (literal):** And-Elijah the-Tishbite, from-the-settlers-of Gilead, said to-Ahab, "As-YHWH lives, the-God-of Israel, before-whom I-stand, there-shall-not be these-years dew or-rain, except by the-word-of my-mouth."

**LOGOS (formal):** Now Elijah the Tishbite, of the settlers of Gilead, said to Ahab, "As the LORD, the God of Israel, lives, before whom I stand, there shall be neither dew nor rain these years, except by my word."

**PNEUMA (dynamic):** Now Elijah, from Tishbe in Gilead, confronted Ahab: "As the LORD, the God of Israel, lives — the God I serve — there will be no dew or rain in the coming years unless I say so."

**SOPHIA resolution:** The divergence reflects translation philosophy differences rather than disagreement about the Hebrew text. LOGOS adopted as consensus baseline.

---

### Verse 2
**EMET (literal):** And-the-word-of YHWH came to-him, saying,

**LOGOS (formal):** And the word of the LORD came to him:

**PNEUMA (dynamic):** Then the LORD told Elijah,

**SOPHIA resolution:** The divergence reflects translation philosophy differences rather than disagreement about the Hebrew text. LOGOS adopted as consensus baseline.

---

### Verse 3
**EMET (literal):** "Go from-here and-turn eastward and-hide-yourself by-the-brook Cherith, that is before the-Jordan.

**LOGOS (formal):** "Depart from here and turn eastward and hide yourself by the brook Cherith, which is east of the Jordan.

**PNEUMA (dynamic):** "Leave here. Go east and hide by the brook Cherith, east of the Jordan.

**SOPHIA resolution:** The divergence reflects translation philosophy differences rather than disagreement about the Hebrew text. LOGOS adopted as consensus baseline.

---

### Verse 5
**EMET (literal):** And-he-went and-did according-to-the-word-of YHWH. And-he-went and-dwelt by-the-brook Cherith, that is before the-Jordan.

**LOGOS (formal):** So he went and did according to the word of the LORD. He went and lived by the brook Cherith that is east of the Jordan.

**PNEUMA (dynamic):** Elijah did what the LORD said. He went and stayed by the brook Cherith, east of the Jordan.

**SOPHIA resolution:** The divergence reflects translation philosophy differences rather than disagreement about the Hebrew text. LOGOS adopted as consensus baseline.

---

### Verse 8
**EMET (literal):** And-the-word-of YHWH came to-him, saying,

**LOGOS (formal):** Then the word of the LORD came to him,

**PNEUMA (dynamic):** Then the LORD said to him,

**SOPHIA resolution:** The divergence reflects translation philosophy differences rather than disagreement about the Hebrew text. LOGOS adopted as consensus baseline.

---

### Verse 9
**EMET (literal):** "Arise, go to-Zarephath, that belongs-to-Sidon, and-dwell there. Behold, I-have-commanded there a-widow woman to-provide-for-you."

**LOGOS (formal):** "Arise, go to Zarephath, which belongs to Sidon, and dwell there. Behold, I have commanded a widow there to feed you."

**PNEUMA (dynamic):** "Get up and go to Zarephath in Sidon and stay there. I have directed a widow there to provide for you."

**SOPHIA resolution:** The divergence reflects translation philosophy differences rather than disagreement about the Hebrew text. LOGOS adopted as consensus baseline.

---

### Verse 10
**EMET (literal):** And-he-arose and-went to-Zarephath and-came to the-entrance-of the-city, and-behold — a-widow woman there gathering sticks. And-he-called to-her and-said, "Bring to-me, please, a-little water in-a-vessel, and-I-will-drink."

**LOGOS (formal):** So he arose and went to Zarephath. And when he came to the gate of the city, behold, a widow was there gathering sticks. And he called to her and said, "Bring me a little water in a vessel, that I may drink."

**PNEUMA (dynamic):** So he went to Zarephath. When he arrived at the town gate, a widow was there gathering sticks. He called out to her, "Would you please bring me a little water in a cup so I can have a drink?"

**SOPHIA resolution:** The divergence reflects translation philosophy differences rather than disagreement about the Hebrew text. LOGOS adopted as consensus baseline.

---

### Verse 12
**EMET (literal):** And-she-said, "As-YHWH your-God lives, I-have-no cake — only a-handful-of flour in-the-jar and-a-little oil in-the-jug. And-behold, I am-gathering two sticks, and-I-will-go and-make-it for-me and-for-my-son, and-we-will-eat-it and-die."

**LOGOS (formal):** And she said, "As the LORD your God lives, I have nothing baked, only a handful of flour in a jar and a little oil in a jug. And now I am gathering a couple of sticks that I may go in and prepare it for myself and my son, that we may eat it and die."

**PNEUMA (dynamic):** She replied, "As surely as the LORD your God lives, I don't have a single piece of bread. All I have is a handful of flour in a jar and a little olive oil in a jug. I was just gathering a few sticks to make one last meal for my son and myself. After that, we'll starve."

**SOPHIA resolution:** The divergence reflects translation philosophy differences rather than disagreement about the Hebrew text. LOGOS adopted as consensus baseline.

---

### Verse 13
**EMET (literal):** And-Elijah said to-her, "Do-not fear. Go, do according-to-your-word. But first make for-me from-there a-small cake, and-bring-it-out to-me. And-for-you and-for-your-son you-shall-make afterward.

**LOGOS (formal):** And Elijah said to her, "Do not fear; go and do as you have said. But first make me a little cake of it and bring it to me, and afterward make something for yourself and your son.

**PNEUMA (dynamic):** Elijah said to her, "Don't be afraid. Go home and do as you planned. But first, make a small loaf for me and bring it out. Then make something for yourself and your son.

**SOPHIA resolution:** The divergence reflects translation philosophy differences rather than disagreement about the Hebrew text. LOGOS adopted as consensus baseline.

---

### Verse 14
**EMET (literal):** For thus says YHWH, the-God-of Israel: 'The-jar-of flour shall-not be-finished and-the-jug-of oil shall-not lack, until the-day YHWH gives rain upon the-face-of the-earth.'"

**LOGOS (formal):** For thus says the LORD, the God of Israel, 'The jar of flour shall not be spent, and the jug of oil shall not be empty, until the day that the LORD sends rain upon the earth.'"

**PNEUMA (dynamic):** For this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: 'The flour jar will not run out and the oil jug will not run dry until the day the LORD sends rain on the land.'"

**SOPHIA resolution:** The divergence reflects translation philosophy differences rather than disagreement about the Hebrew text. LOGOS adopted as consensus baseline.

---

— SOPHIA
